what: MergeResult lists already_merged as a ninth merge-pr variant and test_merge_bash_parity requires identical classification to merge-pr.sh, but merge-pr.sh documents and emits only eight MERGE_RESULT values (no already_merged).
scenario_or_breakage: Parity harness or unit table will fail or encode a non-bash outcome; already_merged is set by ship-pr ci-wait ACTION=already_merged and by remapping version_already_published when the PR is already MERGED (scripts/ship-pr.sh:3497-3509,3551-3556), not by merge-pr.sh.
suggested_fix: Limit merge.merge_pr to the eight merge-pr.sh literals; treat already_merged as Phase 7 driver/orchestrator state, or exclude it from test_merge_bash_parity and document the split.
